decisions.text: D1: inspector.py's ticket-falsifier fidelity read (_fidelity_keywords, ~line 215) takes the claims of plan.clauses(ticket). It composes cairn.tools.base.plan (ticket 5c1e0a7d93b2): clauses(doc) gives [{n, claim}] from outcomes that carry a claim, else falsifier.clauses; it keeps no second reading of either shape. The FIXME-answers ledger (~line 2816) stays on decisions: it keys on rehearsal's 'FIXME n' steps, which plan.steps drops.
D2: the red-first proof feeds the reader one ticket in each shape carrying the same content, one tooth per clause.
